gaps: Munro, J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 26, 1195 (1997): the paper PDF itself was not opened; only the NIST SRD 150 summary page was read (it carries no test-geometry or effective-volume data). The paper DOI 10.1063/1.556000 was seen only in a search snippet.

CVD SiC from Dow / Rohm and Haas / CoorsTek: no datasheet with Weibull modulus found. The DTIC CVD SiC characterization reports (ADA285667, ADA327314) returned HTTP 403 and were not opened. The 389 MPa / Weibull 5 CVD figure is a secondary citation (ORNL grinding paper). Goela et al. 1991 table has no Weibull modulus.

SiC/SiC composite: no open source with a tensile strength / proportional-limit table was read (ORNL/Katoh abstracts at impact.ornl.gov carried no numbers; Kowbel flexural 300-350 MPa and ~120 MPa Tyranno-SA proportional limit seen only in search snippets). Only tube hoop data (INL/ORNL 138-172 MPa; KAERI triplex 282 MPa) are recorded.

SiC Hertzian contact: Auerbach-law critical loads (N) for SiC with steel or WC spheres were not found in text. ORNL ring-crack-force values (Wereszczak et al. 2009, 2011) are plotted in figures only or sit behind paywalls; OSTI full text purl returned 404. No numeric ring-crack load was recorded.

SiC low-velocity impact thresholds in 1-60 m/s: only the GE/NASA 1976 CR-134990 ballistic data (0.29 J at 39 m/s, 0.67 J at 60 m/s on ~9 mm sintered plate) was found with numbers. LaSalvia et al. "Sphere impact induced damage in ceramics I: armor-grade SiC and TiB2" and Henderson et al. (ceramics.org cesp 27-2; HTTP 403) not opened. Henderson ZrB2-SiC "retained strength drop above ~290 m/s" seen only in a search snippet.

SiC tube impact: no drop-weight, transverse-impact or lateral-crush test on SiC or SiC/SiC tubes (ORNL/INL) was found; only internal-pressure, diametral-compression, C-ring and sectored-flexure tests. Strength degradation of SiC after Vickers/Hertzian contact damage (indentation-strength curves) not found for SiC; NIST SCD results returned for that query were Si3N4.
Effective volume / area for the datasheet and NIST flexure values is not printed on any page read (Hexoloy sheet gives only bar size 3 x 4 x 45 mm).

Zylon/PBO FILM: no source found for a PBO film or 0/90 filament film (tear, puncture, cut). Toyobo publishes fibre data only; the Toyobo cut-resistance or abrasion-by-sharp-edge numbers were not found (Section 9.5 is fibre-to-metal abrasion only). NASA Glenn Pereira/Revilock ballistic tests of Zylon AS FABRIC (NTRS 20080013150) were downloaded but are high-velocity fabric containment tests and were not recorded.

Tear of Kapton or Zylon film UNDER BIAXIAL TENSION at ~100 kN/m line load (membrane tear growth versus stress and slit length): not found for Kapton, Mylar or PBO. Only polyethylene balloon film (Portanova 1989; Hegyi 2013) has tension-state fracture data. NASA solar sail CP1 / Kapton tear data (NTRS 20100039163 status report) was downloaded but gave no tear numbers; the 1978 ILC Dover table is the only Kapton tear-under-sail-design data found.

Montana State thesis "Investigation of membrane tearing characterization and healing" (Mylar and Kapton essential work of fracture; search snippet quotes about 37 kJ/m2 for Mylar 25.4, 50.8, 76.2 um): connection failed (socket hang up / TLS errors); not opened, so no numbers recorded. Kuusipalo et al. J. Mater. Sci. 2004 (PET trouser tear 12-25 kJ/m2) and Wong et al. Acta Mater. 2003 (EWF tearing of PETG): publisher page blocked (JavaScript challenge) or not opened; figures seen only in search snippets.

Scientific-balloon super-pressure film: Rand and Wakefield (2010, Adv. Space Res.), Said (fabric-film laminate tear, NTRS 19980237946, 19990064447; text layer unreadable OCR), Seshadri, Smith papers: not recovered with usable numbers.
